prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent eight-pose inspection-agent source sheet
Primary request: Create one cohesive full-body pixel-art sheet of the NEW inspection agent in Image2. Image1 controls v6e STYLE, proportions and the eight-pose layout only. Image2 controls this NEW identity and every clothing/clipboard detail: a 44-year-old adult woman with golden-tan skin, straight black blunt chin-length bob with a side part, no glasses, and a sturdy wider-waisted build. They wear a charcoal blazer over a muted burgundy collared blouse, full-length warm beige trousers, plum loafers. Their thin dark lanyard ends in a small blank badge. Preserve its face, hair, skin, build, exact garment colors and right-hand clipboard.
Composition/framing: EXACTLY TWO rows of FOUR isolated figures, eight poses total. TOP row left-to-right standing SOUTH/front, EAST/profile facing screen-right, WEST/profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. BOTTOM row same order seated SOUTH/EAST/WEST/NORTH. Seated figures sit on INVISIBLE chairs with knees bent around 90 degrees and feet flat. Each figure remains a single connected silhouette. Broad transparent gutters, generous empty row gap and outer margins; standing shoes and seated heads cannot touch. Same head/body scale standing and seated; no shrinking seated figures. Professional nonclinical inspector/surveyor attire: full-length tailored trousers, ordinary office shoes, blazer/cardigan/button-down as specified, a thin muted lanyard with a small blank rectangular badge. Sleeves full length in every pose. NO scrubs, V-neck clinical tops, white coats, stethoscope, surgical caps or medical equipment. Blank badge only, no text/logos. Preserve garment colors, shirt collar, jacket/cardigan hem, hair and face across directions. MANDATORY CLIPBOARD IN EVERY POSE: ONE warm tan wooden clipboard with dark brown rim, small silver top clip and off-white blank paper. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds it at the person's own RIGHT-FRONT waist. Never swap to the left hand. SOUTH/front: board and gripping right hand are on SCREEN-LEFT. EAST/right-facing profile: right hand and board are on the NEAR side. WEST/left-facing profile: right hand stays on the FAR side, with board's leading corner visible beyond the front torso. NORTH/rear: board remains in FRONT of the body, mostly hidden; show a narrow tan edge beside the right forearm on SCREEN-RIGHT, never on screen-left or behind the back. The same right elbow is bent in every view; the other arm is relaxed. Keep the board physically connected to the gripping hand, never detached. No readable writing, checkmarks or fake glyphs. SEATED: the SAME clipboard rests naturally on the LAP over the anatomical RIGHT thigh, supported by the SAME RIGHT hand. Do not hold it upright floating in front of the knees. In south/front the right-side lap board is on screen-left. East is the near-hand lap view. West keeps the right hand on the far side with a slim board corner visible at the front of the lap. North keeps the board on the front lap, naturally torso-occluded; only its right-side sliver is visible on screen-right beside the right forearm. It is never transferred to the left hand.
Style/medium: Exactly match Image1: compact rounded pixel-art adult proportions, large expressive head, clean dark pixel-stepped outline of the same weight, restrained two/three-tone cel shading, muted palette family, crisp softly shaded pixel finish. Same head-to-body ratio as v6e and v6d. No taller realistic, glossy, vector-flat, painterly or photorealistic figures. All views have the same proportional scale.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background. No visible chair/furniture/floor, cast shadow, glow, extra props/people, scenery, readable text, logos, labels, watermarks, grid, missing/duplicated/cropped poses. Only person, lanyard/blank badge and one physically held clipboard per pose. Appearance is visual only.
